title: Company Law And Business Association I
modules: Development Of Company Law In Nigeria
mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is described as an association of a number of people for a common object.
A company is described as an association of a number of people for a common object.
Fill in the blank: ______ are known as the Guilds of Merchants.
The commercial associations are known as the Guilds of Merchants.

Fill in the blank: ______ are a set of rules governing the running of the company or rules framed by the members themselves regulating the way business of the company as defined in the memorandum of association shall be managed.

The article of association are a set of rules governing the running of the company or rules framed by the members themselves regulating the way business of the company as defined in the memorandum of association shall be managed.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the study of law regulating the management and regulation of companies.
Company law itself is the study of law regulating the management and regulation of companies.
fib: ______ is the most elementary type of business organization; the business involves only the individual himself going into business on his own, without the involvement of any outsider.
The sole trader is the most elementary type of business organization; the business involves only the individual himself going into business on his own, without the involvement of any outsider.
______ are the subscribers, as members liable, in any shape or form, except to the extent and in the manner provided by the Act.
Nor are the subscribers, as members liable, in any shape or form, except to the extent and in the manner provided by the Act.
______ is a legal entity, existing separate and distinct from its shareholders is a legal theory established upon an expedient theory.
The doctrine that company is a legal entity, existing separate and distinct from its shareholders is a legal theory established upon an expedient theory.
______ is the person responsible for forming the company.
The promoter is the person responsible for forming the company.
